_about: Atlas's additions to rela's description: rules the current rela cannot hold, because it refuses unknown keys in schema.yaml. State merges this file into the description it answers, key by key; Control applies the rules for any kind. Data, not code: no BEAM module names a kind. Per kind: create.ask = the only fields a create form asks for; create.id = how the id is made (prefix plus the next free number, zero-padded to digits); nobody ever types or changes an id; create.defaults = values for the fields create does not ask; properties.<name>.set_by = a field only a connector or the system fills (never in a form, shown only when it has a value); properties.<name>.multiline = true for text of several lines and sections (a form edits it in a multi-line editor; the line breaks are kept).
